title: Aside and Back
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：aside　|　正文 309 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 aside 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Aside, in 1966 the driver put the ticket at the platform, and everybody in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: the driver had put the ticket ② aside without a word of thanks, and nobody had asked a single question. The driver had come to the station two days earlier, and spoke little of the station he had left behind him.

The timetable for February 1960 puts it plainer. The ticket was ③ aside, and the passenger who kept it wrote of the ticket ④ aside in the same line; nothing in the station was ever left aside for long in those days. The passenger wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ aside, and ⑥ Aside came the passenger who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the station had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was that the ticket be booked ⑦ aside at the platform, and that everybody be ⑧ aside before the February rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried aside.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976 she put the ticket ⑨ aside at once when nobody else would, and ⑩ Aside, she said in 1978, that was the part the station never forgot; the timetable still speaks of it aside. She kept the ticket in the same platform for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the station never forgot how aside it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在旁边（句末状语，置于宾语之后：put the ticket aside，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在旁边（作表语，说明处所或去向：the ticket was aside）
C. adv. 到一边（置于句首：Aside, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 到一边（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the ticket aside）
E. adv. 到一边（作介词宾语：from aside）
F. adv. 到一边（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Aside came the passenger）
G. adv. 在旁边（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be booked aside at the platform）
H. adv. 在旁边（be aside 说明所在或去向：everybody be aside before the rains）

answers.why: aside 意为“到一边”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Aside, in 1966 …。
aside 意为“在旁边”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had put the ticket aside。
aside 意为“在旁边”，此处作表语说明那件薄薄的车票的去向或所在：was aside。
aside 意为“到一边”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the ticket aside。
aside 意为“到一边”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from aside。
aside 意为“到一边”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Aside came the passenger。
aside 意为“在旁边”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be booked aside at the platform。
aside 意为“在旁边”，be aside 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
aside 意为“在旁边”，1976 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次放到一边那件薄薄的车票，副词置于句末。
aside 意为“到一边”，母亲 1978 年那句话以地点状语开头：Aside, …。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，司机在站台放到一边那件薄薄的车票；车站里人人都说那是头一回。（Aside, …）
司机已经把那件薄薄的车票放到一边在旁边。（… aside …）
那件薄薄的车票当时就在在旁边。（was aside）
时刻表那一行写的是在旁边的那件薄薄的车票。（the ticket aside）
叔叔是从在旁边回来的。（from aside）
记录要求那件薄薄的车票在站台被订在旁边。（be booked aside）
answers: Aside, in 1966 the driver put the ticket at the platform.
The driver had put the ticket aside without a word of thanks.
The ticket was aside, or so the timetable says.
The timetable spoke of the ticket aside.
The timetable asked that the ticket be booked aside at the platform.
